summary: Invoke [[PreventExtensions]] and return its boolean status rather than returning the target.

target.notes: Dispatch through the ECMAScript object/internal-method runtime so Proxy traps, property descriptors, coercion, abrupt completion, and boolean-vs-throw behavior are preserved.

semantics.proxy: preventExtensions trap result is checked against actual target extensibility

caveats: Unlike Object.preventExtensions, Reflect.preventExtensions returns a boolean and requires an Object target.
Do not replace this with C# reflection or ordinary property access when JavaScript object-model behavior is observable.

tests.name: proxy may report false without throwing
